brand.name: Suhbah
brand.sector: Shared worship tracker app for Muslims

sentence.en: Two people, one arc. Log your prayers and watch your day fill up together.

set.name: Tile and Lamp
set.mechanism: A glazed tile under lamplight: a deep blue half and an amber half on warm paper, so the arc reads like a dome seen at dusk.
set.expression_move: The warm paper ground carries the mood; the arc stays simple.
set.differs_by: Breaks the category's green entirely. Blue and amber are the well-rated orange with navy direction, and no named competitor owns it.

logo.concept: The same arc, read as a tiled dome lit from one side.

rationale.claim: The arc mark and both typefaces are kept from the app as the founder approved them; only the colours change between sets.
Orange with navy is among the better rated colour directions (O'Donovan 2011, Schloss and Palmer 2011).
